messages:
Samir: quick heads-up — I'm reworking the dedicated provisioning doc to make autoscale + isolation behavior clearer during preemption and reserved-pool fallback. Draft PR is up. Need reviewers for SLA wording, a clear eviction-order example, and two SDK snippets (py/go).

Leila: link?

Samir: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/578 (draft). Major items:
- 'isolation decorators' section
- explicit eviction order example + short sequence diagram
- 'burst_policy' YAML example for tenants
- python + go SDK snippets for tenant labels & provisioning
- migration checklist with rollback pointers

Rahul: will take a look at the runtime behavior notes and confirm the eviction sequence matches what the serving runtime does. Also watch wording around 'best-effort' — customers misread that as SLA.

Maya: can we add a tiny concrete example for eviction order? Ops keeps asking whether reserved pools always win.

Samir: good call — added a minimal annotated sequence and an example YAML. pasted below for quick eyeballs:
```yaml
# burst policy example for tenant X
burst_policy:
  max_burst: 200
  preemption_priority: low
  reserved_pool: true
  fallback: reserved_pool->shared_pool->degraded_throughput
```

Leila: looks reasonable. found two broken links via the link-checker running on the branch. docs-bot — can you paste?

docs-bot: Automated link-checker report: 2 broken links detected in pr/578:
- /dedicated/old-terminology -> 404
- /sdk/python/legacy-tenant -> 404
Please fix or add redirects.

Samir: thanks. fixed both and pushed a small commit that adds redirects + updates the SDK path.

Maya: SDK snippets — the python one in the PR still uses the legacy client shape. should be this pattern now:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
client.dedicated.provision(tenant_id="acme", config={"burst_policy": {...}})
```

Samir: updated Python snippet to that form, and added a Go example too: 
```go
cli := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
cli.Dedicated().Provision(ctx, "acme", provisionConfig)
```

Rahul: I'll test the eviction example in staging tomorrow and validate the fallback ordering. If we discover mismatches I'll add a short runtime note in the doc explaining conditions where eviction order can differ (preemption windows, node isolation).

Leila: I'll own the SLA wording and migration checklist. Plan to clarify the phrasing around 'degraded throughput' vs 'SLA-backed outage' and add an explicit 'what to expect' table for customers migrating from hosted to dedicated.

Samir: awesome — target is to merge by EOD Friday. If anyone has more examples (terragrunt snippet, terraform snippet, live rollout checklist), drop them directly on the PR. :rocket:

Leila: :thumbsup: I can add a short terragrunt example later today.

Maya: ping me when Rahul finishes the staging test; I'll do a quick smoke of the SDK snippets.

Samir: thanks all — will post a final check-in once CI + link-checker are green.
